initial_oracle_failure_resolved.cause: Algebraically collapsing zoom and channel mapping moved an exact integer coordinate by 7e-15 px across the existing 1/32 interpolation-phase boundary.
initial_oracle_failure_resolved.resolution: Reference pixels preserve the defined two stages; independent one-expression coordinates are also asserted within 1e-11 px. Pixel tolerance remains 2e-6. No production or sampler change.

boundaries: Android framework/adapter/repository/recovery/ViewModel logic and private files ran under Robolectric on host.
CodecNativeApi test double provided synthetic 8x8 linear pixels and warning/policy responses; this gate does not validate optical formulas, RAW decoding, or Android JNI.
Only the existing unrelated verifyEffectAudioAssets and preparePackedEngineAssets packaging tasks were excluded; build.gradle and dependency checks were unchanged.
new_coverage: Eight exact optics codes remain independent, deduplicate, reject unknown/malformed code variants, discard native free text, and restore localized resource keys in zh/en/ja/ko.
Three v1→v2 policy routes regenerate pixels and messages exactly once, retain borrowed v1 files, and subsequently reuse their v2 spool.
Each of three routes exercises DISK_BUDGET, MEMORY_BUDGET and DECODE_FAILED preservation of original/session/old spool/sidecar through PrivateWorkRecovery followed by explicit successful retry.
Actual EditorViewModel failure state does not retry during virtual time advance; duplicate manual retry taps start one attempt; Later preserves saved keys and files.

visual_review.method: Reviewed generated real production JPEG pairs and 100% fixed-coordinate PNG crop sheets. No post hoc ROI changes, exposure matching or registration.

recommended.observation: Moderate edge-brightness change is visible; center changes little. Real illumination gradients remain. This is not a laboratory uniform flat field.
Edge and corner brightening is visually clear while the existing straightened brick-wall geometry is retained. It demonstrates the new combined output, not TCA in isolation.
Peripheral brightness change is clear. The same JPEG export also clips more roof highlights after gain; do not treat the mixed brightness/colour change as isolated proof of TCA.
Green/magenta fringes on the neutral white door-frame and railing edges are visibly reduced with the original TCA coefficients. Both sides use the same source-vignetting correction and new codec.

Changes in these leafy 100% crops are subtle. The selected scene does not support claiming a dramatic visual improvement; the coefficients/control and production numeric validation provide the stronger evidence.

other_visual_findings: The three Olympus pairs show no visible new overall brightness correction, consistent with their displayed TCA-only support. Do not advertise these grey-field samples as vignetting-corrected.
No obvious new black edge bands or gross geometric distortion were visible in the reviewed comparison frames. This visual observation does not replace the numerical domain certification.

reproduction.controls: Start from the source SHA, apply only each listed absolute byte patch after verifying before_hex, then check the control SHA. Preserve the original.

limits: No Android device runtime or APK validation is claimed. Application host JNI uses a test double; native host JNI and real codec decoding are separate gates.
Unexecuted historical external-fixture tests are named by native_release_gate; only the two current optical metadata fixture tests were additionally enabled.
Optional Olympus embedded vignetting is not implemented; no model or gain is inferred from a shading flag.
Lensfun automatic scope remains the exact approved EOS R + RF16 CR3 combination.
Source coefficients and fixed reference formulas do not establish physical calibration accuracy for every lens or parity with an entire third-party RAW renderer.
The RX100 II independent table-count extension and Olympus reference composition choice are explained in EMBEDDED-OPTICS-MODELS.md.
At unchanged export exposure vignetting raises highlights as well as shadows. Canon9423 JPEG clipping increases; the linear RGB retains values above 1. Main RF16 comparison uses Canon9561.
Original RAW data and full floating-point outputs are not redistributed in the repository.
